trecho.2: ino, surgindo por detrás de dois recobrimentos o que quase submerge as imagens, uma superfície de plumas; e a transparência do acetato estampado pelos prefixos superlativos (afinal é barroco, é antropofagia cultural e é natureza superlativa... e morta): hiper, super, supra... Ou ainda, na matemática subvertida em que a soma de duas parcelas implica em um produto que é mais do que elas é efeito de cópula (como propunha Eisenstein em sua análise da função do ideograma comparado à montagem cinematográfica [7]), sempre mais do que se espera... sempre outra coisa. Um trabalho chamado Futurista - O Casamento de Mme. X com Marcel Duchamp parece colocar em jogo esta possibilidade: um fantasma/manequim, usando um vestido (de noiva?) de Márcia X, que tem no lugar da cabeça um ventilador da década de 30, da marca Marinetti (!!). Como anotação/comentário, está aí o (um dos) produto(s) do percurso de rupturas da história da arte no século XX. Amálgama e inscrição efêmera... para se guardar a fórmula e reaplicá-la. O ângulo adequado para se poetizar o mundo: reduzindo “um problema intrincado a pontos simples e claros...”. Diversão e complexidade, como deve ser a vida. Marilia Panitz Mestre em Te

trecho.4: the prophet and the ocelot nature x culture = barbarism o casamento de Márcia X com Marcel Ducham The death of Lygia: What would you do alone and anonymous at the wake of another anonymous person whom you later discovered to be Lygia Clark?… A poetic proposal that recognizes the unusualness of the fact (which is real). Maybe another tombstone. A FIKE that challenges the fiber of the modernist proposal taken to its extreme (its end). The red, blue, and yellow ribbons offer fitting homage to one who challenged these extremes and eliminated the barriers between art and (other) things of this world (with its many other fibers challenged in various works). trecho.5: m behind two coverings that nearly submerge the images: first, a coating of feathers and, next, a transparent sheet of acetate imprinted with superlative prefixes (it is, after all, Baroque, it is cultural anthropophagy, it is nature, both superlative… and dead): hyper, super,supra... Or, even, in that subversive mathematics where the whole is greater than the sum of its parts, a copulative effect (as put forth by Eisenstein in his comparison of the function of the ideogram with cinematographic editing) always producing more than expected,… always something new. A work entitled Futurist – the marriage of Márcia X and Marcel Duchamp seems to hold out this possibility: a ghost/mannequin, wearing a dress (bridal gown?) of Marcia’s, has, where the head should be, a Marinetti (!!) fan from the 30’s. As a footnote/commentary, right there is (one of) the product(s) of the procession of ruptures in art history of the 20th century. Fusion and ephemeral inscription…the formula may be saved and re-applied. The angle is just right for poeticizing the world: reducing “a complex problem to simple, clear points…”. Fun and complex, just as life should be. Marilia Panitz MA in Art History and Theor

trecho.7: he monster’s dwelling The fantastic beast is always an offense to Creation, probably because it implies that something was left lacking the first time. Salah Stétié slyly insinuates that the appearance of exotic man-made bestiaries is nothing more than a symptom of the limits of God’s imagination (44). On the other hand, these fictitious animals also bear in their features evidence of all the anguish and terror projected onto them by humans, for whom they, like all other animals, whether wild or domestic, represent alien, impenetrable beings. Why not just say that this marvelous fauna, unholy marriage of dream and nightmare, is the symptom of the limits of man’s reality? Balanced on a line between God and Man, we begin to contemplate the question of objects, whether the inanimate is capable of distilling a live organism. The resulting hybrid body might be like the strange creature proffered by Wagner Barja in São João Beuys (1990) (St. John Beuys), in which a small household shrine dedicated, in this case, to St. John the Baptist, bizarrely metamorphoses into an animal appointed with a large lambskin tail. to be or not to be, for Gullar
